$comment: Keyward's starter apps: every new workspace gets them in its Apps tab, refreshed on a schedule (UTC).

apps.name: Urgent and overdue
apps.description: Every weekday at 07:00: urgent tickets and tickets past their fix-by date, by building.
apps.brief: List every open maintenance ticket that is urgent or past its fix-by date, grouped by {account}: the defect, where it is, its stage, the vendor, the fix-by date and how many days late. Urgent ones first. End with a count per {account}.

apps.name: Contracts renewing
apps.description: Every Monday: service contracts renewing in the next 60 days.
apps.brief: List every service contract that renews in the next 60 days, by {account}: vendor, trade, renewal date, annual value and the number of tickets that vendor closed late this quarter.
